featured_reviews.name: Kay Kalsi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Don't make the same mistake I did. After reading these reviews, I’ve realized it’s the same story for everyone: Upstox makes it incredibly easy to deposit your money, but they will hold it hostage the moment you try to leave.

If you want to move your shares or close your account, be prepared for a nightmare. I’ve been waiting 20+ days for a simple transfer that SEBI mandates must be completed in 4 days. Upstox is operating in total defiance of regulatory rules, and they clearly don't care about your time or your assets.

The Reality of Using This App:
▪️Total Blackout: You can bang your head against the wall writing emails and calling support—nobody listens. Not a single response comes from their team in 3 weeks time.

▪️Frozen Assets: They effectively freeze your account when you request a exit. You lose all control over your own money.

▪️Regulatory Failure: I’ve had to file a formal SEBI SCORES complaint just to get a single response.

Ticket #9750599 — Still unresolved after 3 weeks. Save yourself the stress and go with a broker that actually respects the law.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hey, we regret to hear about your experience. Rest assured, we are looking into your concern and will update you at the earliest, on the email ID that is registered with us. For further updates, please refer to ticket number 9750599. We highly appreciate your patience in the meantime.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwani Kumarsinha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had opened my account in upstox  and Vanshika Gill was watching my account. I took the IPO and also gave her 20% rupees. Now she is asking me for 1.5 lakh rupees and tax. I have all the screenshots from which I have sent the money in the account. Till now I have given 7 lakh rupees but now I am not getting any satisfaction result from there.
I have screenshots of all the money I sent. I am sharing some documents. It runs in the name of Ravi Kumar.
My account has also been suspended, now I have no option left except giving a legal action.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Ashwani, thank you for bringing this to our attention. Please note 'Vanshika Gill' is not associated with us. As a precaution, please refrain from sharing your personal information with individuals who claim affiliation with Upstox but are not associated with our organization.

If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it by emailing us at cybersafety@upstox.com or contacting the Cybercrime Department at uptx.to/Cybercrime.

For further assistance, please share your registered contact details here: uptx.to/GMB along with the screenshot/short video which you are referring to and we'll get back to you.

featured_reviews.name: Lajeesh Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Why is Upstox giving wrong advisory picks every day for NIFTY & BANKNIFTY options?

Example:

BANKNIFTY 53800 PE – Entry ₹535.40 → Now ₹408 (loss 24%)

Earlier: NIFTY 24600 CE – Entry ₹135 → collapsed to ₹18.15 (-76%)

These so-called “high potential” calls are only creating losses for retailers and look like a strategy to generate brokerage, not profits for traders.

Why are such misleading picks allowed? Who is responsible?
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Lajeesh, we understand your concern.
 
All our advisory recommendations come with a stop-loss to help protect you from sudden falls. However, in highly volatile markets, stop-loss orders may not trigger as expected if there’s a gap-up/down opening.
 
Please note that all our recommendations are issued under a valid advisory license in full compliance with SEBI and exchange guidelines. We are committed to providing research-driven insights and advice you also do your own research before making any investment decisions.
 
For us to see why this happened, we will need to know more, please dm us our user details and we can help further If you have any further questions, feel free to reach out to us here: uptx.to/GMB

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Rewadkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Disappointed with @upstox  support for partners. Partnership benefits were withdrawn unilaterally despite prior contributions, with no option for discussion or reinstatement. Not the kind of partner experience I expected.

featured_reviews.review_text: Typical fraudulent behaviour by this company. Promises to provide a lifetime free account and then suddenly claims AMC? The support is just as fraudulent as the company, claims that they had mailed regarding the charges 30 days prior, what is even the point of mailing when your initial claim was lifetime free account. Extremely disappointed, cant ever trust a company like this. Have deleted my account and would request others to be safe and never install this unethical thrash.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Gaurav, we've strict ethics and zero tolerance for fraud. We understand the AMC change may surprise you. At Upstox, we’re committed to providing you with a best-in-class trading and investing experience. To continue offering powerful features like the TBT Engine and seamless trading, a nominal maintenance charge is necessary. You can learn more here: uptx.to/MCharge. Also, we had informed you 30 days prior via email. Check for 'Latest Features & Key Updates on Upstox.' If you have any other queries, feel free to reach out to us here: uptx.to/GMB

A flat ₹25 fee instead of a 25-35% commission. A decade-old rider fleet built for speed. A fresh tie-up with Magicpin for 80,000+ restaurants on day one.

The food delivery game just got its most interesting challenger yet. 

The question is whether an edge built on cost can survive a market that runs on margins this thin.

A market leader doesn’t always mean a settled race.
This late-2025 snapshot highlights just how competitive India’s quick commerce space was, and while the pecking order may keep shifting, the battle for consumers is far from over. 📦🚀
Who do you think wins the next phase of this race?

For years, SpaceX lived in that strange category of companies everyone knew, but almost nobody could own.

People tracked private valuations, chased secondary market updates, and built watchlists around a stock that wasn’t even public.

Now, that’s changing.

Not because SpaceX suddenly became more valuable.
But because a dinner-table conversation can finally find its way into everyday portfolios.

Some companies become products.
Some become public markets. 🚀📈

Knowledge has shaped every great leap forward. It has inspired discoveries, powered innovation, and transformed possibilities into progress. Since 1987, Motilal Oswal has applied the power of knowledge to one enduring purpose: Wealth Creation.

Today, the brand takes the next step in its evolution from 'think equity. think motilal oswal' to 'think wealth creation'. This new expression reflects the journey of Motilal Oswal from an equity-focused institution to a trusted destination for comprehensive wealth creation.

 Strengthening this evolution is our new Arrow Mnemonic; a simple yet powerful symbol of progress, aspiration, conviction, and forward momentum. More than a visual device, it represents the direction we help our clients take as they pursue their financial goals and long-term wealth aspirations.

As our identity evolves to reflect who we are today and where we aspire to go tomorrow, our purpose remains unchanged: helping investors navigate their journey towards long-term wealth creation with knowledge, discipline, and conviction.
An evolved identity. The same enduring purpose.

The states driving India’s growth story aren’t necessarily the ones making the headlines.

The latest data reveals a surprising shift. 📈

Everyone sees the battle between Jio and Airtel.

But the biggest opportunity may be hiding behind the towers, cables and AI-powered networks that make 5G possible.

After losing the smartphone war, Nokia quietly reinvented itself into one of the key companies powering India's digital infrastructure.

So while telecom giants fight for subscribers, Nokia earns from the backbone of the entire ecosystem.

The question is: Could infrastructure be the smarter bet than operators? 👀

For years, scale built India's biggest brands.

Today, relevance is rewriting the rules.

Can legacy giants keep up, or will D2C brands shape the next decade of consumer demand?
